Brace

Source: R/numbers.R
BraceClass.Rd

A curly brace spanning a mobject on the side given by direction. BraceLabel() adds a label at its tip, BraceText() uses Text() for the label, BraceBetweenPoints() spans two points and ArcBrace() follows an arc.

Usage

Brace(
  mobject,
  direction = DOWN,
  buff = 0.2,
  sharpness = 2,
  stroke_width = 0,
  fill_opacity = 1,
  background_stroke_width = 0,
  background_stroke_color = "#000000",
  ...
)

BraceLabel(
  obj,
  text,
  brace_direction = DOWN,
  label_constructor = MathTex,
  font_size = DEFAULT_FONT_SIZE,
  buff = 0.2,
  brace_config = NULL,
  ...
)

BraceText(obj, text, label_constructor = Text, ...)

BraceBetweenPoints(point_1, point_2, direction = ORIGIN, ...)

ArcBrace(arc = NULL, direction = RIGHT, ...)

Arguments

mobject, obj

The mobject to brace.

direction

Side of the mobject.

buff

Gap between mobject and brace.

sharpness

Sharpness of the brace tip.

stroke_width, fill_opacity, background_stroke_width, background_stroke_color

Style.

...

Passed to VMobject() (for BraceLabel(), to the label constructor).

text

Label text (a string or a vector of strings).

brace_direction

Side of the mobject.

label_constructor

Label constructor, MathTex() by default.

font_size

Label font size.

brace_config

List of extra Brace() arguments.

point_1, point_2

End points.

arc

An Arc().

Value

A mobject: an R6 object of the class named by the function called. The objects whose names end in Class are the R6 class generators that these functions call.

Examples

sq <- Square()
b <- Brace(sq, DOWN)
